verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms that https://www.usemotion.com/llms.txt serves a text/plain, agent-oriented overview of the calendar, meeting assistant, tasks and pricing, and it mentions API access for managing projects and tasks. It is a product and marketing summary rather than an index of developer docs, and docs.usemotion.com returns an HTML app shell at /llms.txt instead of a docs index. missing for 10: an llms.txt (or llms-full.txt) on the docs site, evidence that the llms.txt links to the API reference or cookbooks, independent corroboration of agents using it.
